page.content:
Seventh-century monk whose India pilgrimage the novel mythologizes.

How Xuanzang connects

  • Character: Tang Sanzang — The historical Xuanzang is the model for Tang Sanzang.
  • Work: Journey to the West (novel) — Xuanzang's pilgrimage is the historical seed of the novel.

What is Xuanzang?

Xuanzang left Tang Chang'an in 629, studied at Nalanda, and returned with scriptures. The novel's Tang Sanzang is his legendary double — gentler, more endangered, and escorted by converted demons.

Key threads lead to Tang Sanzang and Journey to the West (novel).
